content: 9front arm64 toolchain = 7a/7c/7l (sys/src/cmd/7a,7c,7l), added Apr 2019 from Charles Forsyth's arm64 compiler suite. 7c OFILES: cgen enam list machcap peep pgen pswt reg sgen swt txt mul; HFILES gc.h 7.out.h ../cc/cc.h; links ../cc/cc.a (object-independent code shared with all compilers). pcc.c objtype map: {"arm64","7c","7l","7","7.out"}. libmach support in libmach/7.c (Mach marm64: kernel base 0xFFFFFFFF80000000, user stack top 0x00007FFFFFFF0000, segment alignment 0x10000).
